notes.title: SPRING NEWS & TEASER FOR UPCOMING GAME
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42164866/89da0c71fa424abd48e68616ac09c20b51e1ad84.jpg[/img]
[i]You tentatively open the old cardboard box, and a plume of dust fills the air of the dimly-lit workshop. In the dark you see two empty eyes staring back. As your eyes adjust to the gloom, the unmistakable curves of a female robot glint in the lamplight. 

"I've never been ever been able to get her to start-up, and I doubt an older model like this will hold up in a competetive battle, but you get what you paid for. She's all yours, kid. Good luck."[/i]

[h3][b]A new game by Sinner's Lotion is in development.[/b][/h3]
You've always dreamt of owning your own sexy robot. With the national robot championships now taking place, you decide to take the plunge and sell everything you own to buy your own bot and shoot your shot for ultimate glory.

This is a turn-based combat game where your customized robot is thrust into the arena to fight in classic strategy combat. Explore the city and discover dozens of hot girls to battle to win new parts and funds upgrade your ultimate robot!

After the hard-fought battles, get to know your fellow robot-enthusiasts a little more intimately, or lay your robot down for some hands-on repairs with extensive fully-animated hentai sequences.

[h3][b]What we can reveal right now:[/b][/h3][list]
[*] The game's name and Steam page will be unveiled late May 2025
[*] You will be able to toggle sex between male/female and male/futa (after a lot of feedback we're adding female/futa as a playable character
[*] The team is the exact same team behind EdgeLords
[*] The early-access release window is around July-September 2025

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42164866/c1b699ade506262d4ff046a2f623549e7156ef7e.jpg[/img]
Please feel free to join our Patreon for FREE to receive updates on the robot game and even get early access.

[b][url=https://www.patreon.com/c/sinners_lotion]https://www.patreon.com/c/sinners_lotion[/url][/b]

Thank you for your continued support. We couldn't do any of this without you, and we hope to continue to provide you fun, sexy games.

[h3][b]Version 1.3 news![/b][/h3]
Game version 1.3.0.3 is still in open beta. Its taking a little longer than usual because of the sheer volume of added content (and I had to transfer the EdgeLords programmer to our robot project), the EdgeLords update is all finished and coded - you can play it right now by switching over the beta mode (instructions below), but there's a lot of bugs.

Once this new robot game is released, it will give us the funding we need to finish the bugfixing and release EdgeLords 1.3.

But Unity is so unstable I can't approve it to be released until I can ensure it will give the best possible play experience. When the build is ready, it will be called version 1.3.1.0 Here's the full list of content to be added in version 1.3.1.0:
[list]
[*] Steam Workshop integration
[*] 2 animated CGs (both anal!)
[*] 20+ Still CGs (bringing the total to over 70)
[*] 3 new characters (exclusive to Pro-Create for now)
[*] 100 card rebalances (mostly Ashka decks)
[*] 200 bugfixes (working with Unity is agony)
[/list][h3][b]New to the EdgeLords?[/b][/h3]
Welcome to EdgeLords! A fun single-player card game with a solid difficulty curve.
EdgeLords curently lacks a tutorial, so you will be thrown into the deep end.
The card game is very simple to play, but it can provide a good challenge!
[b]Some hints:[/b][list]
[*] Gauntlet mode is the best beginner-friendly game mode
[*] Discard unwanted cards by dragging them into icon in the bottom-left corner
[*] Check out the Game [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1871480/guides/]Guides[/url]
[/list][h3][b]Experience the magic of Pro-Creation![/b][/h3]
Game version 1.3 is now in open beta! Adding a new [b]Card Editor and Steam Workshop[/b] Mode!
As of version 1.3.0.3 uploads to Steam Workshop don't appear, but if you make them now you can upload them when version 1.3.1.0 is ready.

[h3][b]How to access EdgeLords v1.3 Beta:[/b][/h3]
This is our [b]fourth[/b] game mode, and I wanted to thank everyone for their incredible support through EdgeLord's development. With the new Pro-Create editor, you'll be able to create, upload and download your own custom cards, decks and battle using the Steam Workshop. I can't wait to play your incredible challenges!
To access the beta:
[olist]
[*] Right click EdgeLords in your Steam library and select properties
[*] In the 'betas' tab, select 'public_beta' from the drop-down menu
[/olist][list]
[*] You can opt-out of the beta at any time by switching beta participation to default.
[*] Be advised - this is still in beta and bugs will appear, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1871480/discussions/1/4041483920920165351/]report any bugs in the relevant forum[/url].
[*] Pro-Create card editor can be very complex, be sure to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3119136895]read the guide[/url] and if you need help [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1871480/discussions/3/]browse the forums[/url].
[*] Browse the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=1871480&browsesort=lastupdated&section=readytouseitems&snr=2_groups_partnerevents_]Steam Workshop[/url] to download new battles
[*] EdgeLords 1.3 will exit beta once all the bugs are resolved
[/list]Big thanks [b]Snek[/b] for beta testing ːEdgeLordsDeathgripː
Thanks again for all of your continued support! We couldn't do it without you!
Bugs and balancing issues may still be present. Please report any you find!

notes.content:

[b]Happy Halloween![/b] Here's a treat!
The game has been updated to version 1.2! Adding a new [b]Puzzle Challenge[/b] Mode!
To access the Puzzle Challenge - click the Pumpkin icon in the game mode select screen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42164866/969ede38ba76762580d899e57f9035b8683542de.jpg[/img]
Big thanks [b]Snek[/b] and [b]Nikki Sensei[/b] for their outstanding contributions to the community! ːmachikoː

[h3][b]New Game Mode - Puzzle Challenge:[/b][/h3]
[i]This is not a timed seasonal event. These are perminent additions![/i]
[list]
[*] Defeat your opponent with just the cards in your hand and the minions in play!
[*] 8 brain-tickling Puzzle Challenge levels!
[*] 2 New Puzzle Challenge CGs!
[*] 6 New music tracks inspired by the spooky season!
[/list]
[h3][b]QOL Updates in v1.2:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] 8 New 'Completionist' CGs - Clear all Classic or Gauntlet modes in all outfits for a character to unlock!
[*] Updated intro animations to be more cinematic
[*] Bosses in Gauntlet mode now 'retreat' and their animated CGs only play in the final stage
[/list]
[h3][b]In-progress![/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Dialogue controller during cutscenes
[*] Steam Trading Cards
[*] Steam Trading Card Badges
[*] Steam Emotes
[*] Steam Backgrounds
[*] Interaction UI overhaul
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42164866/07b7fe20e013282c22d2302d56fb97e004e15038.png[/img]
[h3][b]Sneak peak at v1.3 Ascension*!!![/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] 3 New voiced and animated minibosses
[*] 12 New Fully animated CGs
[*] 4 New completionist CGs
[*] 3 Miniboss defeat CGs
[*] Ascension campaign (x2 length of Gauntlet!) with full deck editing
[*] Steam Workshop integration for custom characters, cards, puzzles and events!
[*] Voiced pre-battle interactions
[*] Achievements
[*] Tutorial
[/list]

*Ascension is now called Pro-Creation, please note that not all features of Pro-Creation will be avaliable at 1.3's launch. Thank you

[*] Any unspent essence is kept for the next upgrade event
[*] Removed cards are removed for the rest of the campaign

notes.title: Difficulty Patch 1.0.2b is now Live!
notes.content:
[b]The user-requested difficulty patch is now live. This reduces the overall difficulty from Hardcore (Hard) to Competetive (Medium).[/b]

We are continuing to fine-tune the difficulty, in the next few weeks we are planning on developing a difficulty setting to toggle from Casual (Easy), Competetive (Medium) and Hardcore (Hard) and linking it to a new 'essence system'.

In the new 'essence system', players earn essence for completing games, the higher the difficulty, the more essence earned. Essence can then be redeemed on Motifs, CGs and Card Art (this will replace the current unlock system) so you can choose exactly what you'd like to unlock at any time.

User-requested improvements we're working on [b]right now[/b]:
[list]
[*] Steam trading cards, badges and backgrounds (May)
[*] Comprehensive how to play guide (May)
[*] 'BAD END' artwork for EVERY player/boss combination (June)
[*] Viewer for contents of deck and discard piles (June)
[*] More hentai to the gallery (July)
[*] Animation test to gallery (July)
[*] Enhanced rimjobs
[/list]

Thanks again for all of your support! We couldn't do it without you!

notes.title: Difficulty Adjustment Patches In Progress
notes.content:
[b]Over the next couple of days we will be making a number of Balance and Quality of Life improvements to the game to make it more accessible, we thank you for your patience while we work on these edits.[/b]

In the meantime, we're writing a guide for each player and enemy deck to help, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2970439198]check it out here[/url] (section 8.0/9.0)

Thank you for your amazing support so far, especially those on the forums taking the time to share their experiences and recommendations for improvements to Quality of Life.

We understand that a number of users have been frustrated at the intense difficulty of EdgeLords, which was designed to be an intense boss rush where every battle was a photo-finish. But this steep learning curve, combined with a lack of QoL features such as knowing a deck's composition or what cards are currently discarded makes the experience feel too difficult.

You can review and suggest the planned quality of life improvements on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1871480/discussions/0/3830917977321857089/]Steam forums[/url].
And you can review and suggest balance changes over here on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1871480/discussions/2/3394037847182552519/]Steam forums[/url].

notes.title: Softlock discovered in v1.0 - BDSM Ashka Boss
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42164866/9265fd7caf6a2f3c6d769cef3efe192697449637.jpg[/img]
[h3]Issue[/h3]
Regretfully, a softlock has been discovered in v1.0 where the BSDM Ashka Boss (from the Dungeon) attempts to summon 'Harpy'. This results in a softlock. This Boss is currently unwinable and if you come across her I'm afraid that you will need to force quit the application.

[h3]Our Action[/h3]
We will shortly be releasing a patch to resolve this issue.

[h3]Player Action[/h3]
In the meantime, we're afraid that if you come across the BDSM Ashka Boss during your campaign, you will have to force quit the application and start a new game, possibly with a different character. We apologise for this oversight.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42164866/cb9e60cd8cc3ff6024174147b5a5ee80be6384fb.jpg[/img]
[h3]Issue[/h3]
We have also been made aware of a display bug, if you lose a game while in full screen, sometimes the loading screen never goes away. In which case, you will need to close the game manually, you can also avoid this by suspending your game before you are defeated in a match or simply playing in windowed mode. We will patch this shortly.

We sincerely apologise for these unforseen circumstances.
If you have any more bugs to report, please report them in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1871480/discussions/1/]Steam forums[/url].
